moat_against: Single category (beer ~94% of sales post-wine-exit), single supply country (Mexico — tariffs/peso), single demand country (U.S.)
Disproportionate exposure to the Hispanic consumer pullback: flagship depletions negative (Modelo ~-2%, Corona ~-5% in Q2 FY27)
U.S. beer category in secular volume decline; high-end buy rates decelerating for over a year
Net debt $10,194.1M (FY26 end) limits flexibility if the demand downturn persists
moat_for: Modelo Especial is the #1 U.S. beer by dollars; portfolio took price/mix for a decade while gaining share (+0.8 beer share points in Q2 FY27 tracked channels)
Exclusive, perpetual U.S. rights to the Modelo/Corona family plus owned Mexican breweries — no competitor can sell the same brands into its market
Structural margin position: ~39% beer operating margins, premium-only portfolio after the wine exit
Smaller brands compounding off the same distribution (Pacifico top-10 U.S. brand, depletions ~+19%; Victoria ~+15%)
moat_justification: Moderate-strong brands, concentrated and category-capped: Modelo Especial (#1 U.S. beer by dollars) and Corona with exclusive perpetual U.S. rights, owned Mexican breweries, ~39% beer operating margins and a decade of pricing/share gains — against single-category, single-supply-country (Mexico tariffs/peso) and single-demand-country concentration, disproportionate exposure to the Hispanic consumer pullback driving negative depletions, and a U.S. beer category in secular volume decline.
name: Constellation Brands, Inc.
one_liner: Premier import-beer franchise, moat 6/10 — but flagship depletions are negative (Modelo ~-2%, Corona ~-5% in Q2 FY27), FY27 organic sales and comparable EPS are guided flat, and net debt is 5.9x normalized OE, so at $126.37 (median base OE $9.83/share) the weighted IRR is only 9.80% (IV@15% $74.13); it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$74.

shares_override.ack_reason: Out-of-band by construction: the engine has NO filed share value to band against (last_filed_value is null) because companyfacts carries no weighted-share series for this filer at all. The value is not an estimate — it is the diluted weighted average share count printed in the FY2026 10-K EPS note, verified directly in the filing document.
shares_override.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — diluted shares missing for FY2024/2025/2026 (in fact all years) in companyfacts. The filer's own reported FY2026 diluted weighted average count fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period, which leaves the 3-yr median base unchanged (the median of FY24-26 OE/share is the FY2026 figure itself) and is used unprorated by ttm.py as the TTM denominator (vs the H1 FY27 10-Q count of 171.503M — the override denominator is the higher, more conservative one).
shares_override.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended February 28, 2026 (filed 2026-04-22), EPS note and consolidated statements of operations: 'Weighted average common shares outstanding – diluted' 175.568M for FY2026 (FY2025 181.476M, FY2024 183.959M in the same table). EDGAR companyfacts carries no weighted-share series for CIK 16918 (the filer tags share counts with class dimensions the aggregated facts drop), so the engine filed no share value for any period.
